scope: Production textures for the twelve requested moons; optional reconstructed Titan surface.
attribution_requirement: Keep author credits, source links and CC license links available in the site credits; identify modifications. No NASA/USGS/Celestia endorsement is implied.
orientation_warning: All maps are north-up equirectangular. Prime-meridian alignment and epoch are not uniform across sources; scene rotation is illustrative unless separately calibrated.
colour_warning: Cassini six-icy-moon maps are enhanced UV/IR colour. Europa and Callisto are monochrome. Titan visible view is the haze map; surface is a reconstruction.

assets.credit: USGS Astrogeology / NASA/JPL Galileo and Voyager; Tammy Becker, B. Archinal, T. Colvin, M. Davies, A. Gitlin, R. Kirk, L. Weller (2010)
assets.license: US public domain; USGS-produced mosaic; no use constraints
assets.projection: Simple cylindrical / equirectangular; north at top
assets.processing: Lanczos resize to 2048×1024. A nearest-neighbour source zero-data mask identifies gaps. Valid mask eroded 3 px to exclude edge ringing; gaps interpolated along latitude, smoothed with 16 px Gaussian blur and blended at 1 px boundary. Source pixels away from gap margins unchanged. RGB JPEG quality 93, 4:4:4. No AI-generated detail.
notes: Observed monochrome global mosaic. Any material tint added by the renderer is approximate and is not observed per-pixel colour.
Resolution varies strongly by location. Source mosaics include older low-resolution gap images, photometric differences and stitched image boundaries.

Source zero-valued missing coverage is preserved separately in europa-coverage.png (white = observed mosaic, black = missing source). Missing areas are visually filled with smooth interpolation only; no crater/geological details are invented.
assets.longitude_convention: Positive west, 0 to 360 degrees (USGS source metadata)

excluded_candidates: Older Celestia Europa, Callisto, icy Saturn moon and Ceres textures were inspected but omitted because no individual license was verified. Downloaded unused candidates were removed.
Optional Ceres/Vesta not included in the bounded delivery. DLR Vesta preview encountered uses CC-BY-NC-ND and was excluded.
originals: Original large downloads removed after production conversion and hashing to keep the site payload small. Exact source URLs/hashes above allow retrieval. CC license text snapshots are retained under originals/.
visual_validation: All production maps checked on a contact sheet; Europa and Callisto gap handling inspected separately.
